skill.name: domain-profiles
skill.description: Provides domain-specific profiles for learning resource creation across technology, history, science, arts, and general language topics. Each profile defines search strategy, metadata fields, terminology guidance, content structure, and review criteria for researcher and writer agents.
skill.summary: Guides agents with domain-specific research, writing, terminology, and review profiles.
skill.author: BitYoungjae

content.value_statement: Learning resource teams need different search and writing rules for each subject. This skill supplies domain profiles that guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through source selection, terminology, and review.
actual_capabilities: Maps technology, history, science, arts, and general domains to profile files.
Defines source preferences and search query patterns for domain research.
Specifies domain metadata fields for learning resource briefs.
Guides terminology handling, including bilingual term usage where profiles include it.
Provides content structure and review criteria for writer and reviewer agents.
limitations: It provides guidance documents, not executable automation.
It does not verify source accuracy by itself.
It depends on agents reading the correct profile file.
It focuses on learning resource creation, not general content management.

use_cases.title: Plan a Course Module
use_cases.description: Choose the right profile before building a structured lesson for a specific academic domain.

use_cases.title: Guide Research Collection
use_cases.description: Use domain-specific search strategies and source preferences when gathering learning material.

use_cases.title: Review Draft Quality
use_cases.description: Apply profile review criteria to check terminology, structure, examples, and safety expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Load a Domain Profile
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single learning resource.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the domain-profiles skill for a technology learning resource. Read the matching profile and summarize the search strategy, special fields, and content structure.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Research Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the domain-profiles skill for a science topic. Build a research plan using the profile source priorities, search patterns, and quality indicators.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate writing support after research is available.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the domain-profiles skill for an arts lesson. Apply the content structure and terminology policy to improve this draft for learners.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Agent Roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the domain-profiles skill to define which sections researcher, writer, and reviewer agents should use for technology, history, and general topics.

output_examples.input: A writer asks for guidance on a Python tutorial.
output_examples.output: The skill points to the technology profile, prioritizes official documentation, and recommends runnable examples with version notes.

output_examples.input: A research agent receives a history learning topic.
output_examples.output: The skill directs the agent to the history profile and applies that profile's search strategy, special fields, terminology policy, and content structure.

output_examples.input: A reviewer checks a technology lesson.
output_examples.output: The skill highlights forbidden patterns, missing language specifiers, hardcoded secrets, and runnable example expectations from the technology review criteria.

best_practices: Select the domain before invoking the skill so agents load the correct profile.
Use the profile sections that match the agent role.
Pair profile guidance with current source verification for time-sensitive topics.
anti_patterns: Using the technology profile for nontechnical subjects.
Treating profile guidance as source evidence.
Skipping the language profile when the requested domain is general.

faq.question: What domains does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers technology, history, science, arts, and general language topics through separate profile files.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch sources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides search strategies and source preferences for agents that can use research tools.

faq.question: Can it help with Korean learning material?
faq.answer: Yes. Several profiles include guidance for Korean explanations and bilingual terminology.

faq.question: Does it execute code or commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a set of markdown guidance files for agent behavior.

faq.question: Which profile should general topics use?
faq.answer: General topics should use the language profile because there is no separate general profile file.

faq.question: Is this a source of factual truth?
faq.answer: No. It guides research and writing structure, but factual claims still need source verification.
